gizmo.title: Kāleka moʻolelo Polaris
gizmo.description: E hōʻike i kekahi kāleka moʻolelo Polaris me ke kiʻi kāʻei hope, ka lepili kia, a me ke poʻo kikokikona.

configure.title: Kiʻi kāʻei hope
configure.description: URL kiʻi i hōʻike ʻia ma ke ʻano he kāʻei hope o ke kāleka.

configure.title: Nui kāʻei hope
configure.description: Pehea e hoʻopiha ai ke kiʻi kāʻei hope i ke kāleka (CSS background-size).

configure.title: Hoʻopili kāʻei hope
configure.description: Pehea e hana ai ke kiʻi kāʻei hope i ka wā e kaʻa ai (CSS background-attachment).

configure.title: Lepili kia
configure.description: Lepili pōkole hua nui i hōʻike ʻia ma luna o ke kāleka. E waiho hakahaka e hūnā ai.

configure.title: Kikokikona kāleka
configure.description: Kikokikona nui i hōʻike ʻia ma ka papa lalo.

configure.title: Loulou
configure.description: URL koho e hele ai e wahī ana i ke kāleka holoʻokoʻa.
